verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's docs say requests are load-balanced across the top providers by default (openrouter-docs-4). Routing can be customized through the `provider` request object (openrouter-docs-21), and the platform automatically picks the most cost-effective option per request while pooling provider uptime (openrouter-docs-36, openrouter-docs-44). The evidence shows only managed, provider-level balancing with cost awareness, not engineer-controlled weighting across deployments or keys. Missing for 10: explicit weight-based traffic splitting, latency-based routing controls, load balancing across the user's own deployments or BYOK keys, and independent or hands-on corroboration of load-balancing behavior.
